mapper.sql: WITH catalog AS ( SELECT s.external_id, COALESCE(s.display_title, '') AS display_title, s.icon_key, v.description, v.version AS latest_version, s.source, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM skills s JOIN skill_versions v ON v.skill_uuid = s.uuid AND v.workspace_uuid = #{query.WorkspaceUUID} AND v.version = s.latest_version AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.workspace_uuid = #{query.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.external_id, s.display_title, s.icon_key, v.description, v.version AS latest_version, 'anthropic' AS source, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM builtin_skills s JOIN builtin_skill_versions v ON v.skill_uuid = s.uuid AND v.version = s.latest_version AND v.state = 'published' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.listed AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ), filtered AS ( SELECT external_id, display_title, icon_key, description, latest_version, source, created_at, updated_at FROM catalog WHERE strpos(lower(display_title || ' ' || external_id || ' ' || description), lower(#{query.Query})) > 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'anthropic') AS builtin_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'custom') AS custom_count FROM filtered
